stories.title: Road cave-in near Phoenix Mall brings Velachery traffic to a halt
takeaways: A sudden road cave-in on Velachery Main Road near Phoenix Marketcity completely halted traffic before Diwali.
Metrowater officials rushed to inspect the site and coordinate urgent repairs to restore normal traffic flow.

stories.title: GCC makes GPS-tagged photos, videos of road milling mandatory
